description: Install missing shadcn/ui components and npm packages, create all shared/reusable components (Navbar, Footer, CartProvider, ProductCard, VariantSelector, QuantitySelector, CartItemRow, OrderStatusBadge, AddressForm, EmptyState, skeleton components), update app/layout.tsx, and create the (auth) and (dashboard) layout shells. These are dependencies for all page-level features.
steps: Step 1 — Install shadcn components. Only button.tsx exists in components/ui/. Run from c:\E-Commerce: `npx shadcn@latest add --yes badge card dialog drawer input label select separator sheet skeleton tabs textarea`. These are the components needed across all pages. NOTE: they will use @base-ui/react primitives just like button.tsx — do NOT rewrite them after installation.

Step 2 — Verify react-hook-form is NOT in package.json (confirmed missing). Forms will use FormData + server actions (pattern already established in auth-actions.ts and actions/). No react-hook-form install needed.

Step 3 — Create lib/actions/addresses.ts (new server action file) with: getAddresses(), createAddress(), updateAddress(id), deleteAddress(id), setDefaultAddress(id). Uses db + requireAuth(). Returns ApiResponse<Address[]> / ApiResponse<Address> / ApiResponse<null>. Schema is db/schema/addresses.ts: {id, userId, label, addressLine1, addressLine2, city, state, postalCode, country, isDefault}.

Step 4 — Create components/shared/CartProvider.tsx ('use client'). React context with: items:CartItem[], itemCount:number, refresh():void. On mount calls getCart() server action and stores result. Exports useCart() hook. CartItem type from types/cart.ts. The refresh() function re-calls getCart(). Wrap in Suspense-safe way.

Step 5 — Create components/shared/Navbar.tsx (server component). Calls getUser() from lib/auth.ts. Imports Button from @/components/ui/button. Shows: Kartiva logo (text or SVG), nav links (Home /  , Shop /shop), cart icon with item count badge (needs CartItemCount client sub-component that uses useCart()), user dropdown (Account /account, Sign out via signOut action) or Login link. Mobile: hamburger + Sheet from @/components/ui/sheet. Create NavbarClient.tsx alongside it for the client parts (mobile menu, cart badge, user dropdown).

Step 6 — Create components/shared/Footer.tsx (server component). Simple footer: Kartiva name, copyright, nav links (Shop, Account, About), newsletter form placeholder (static UI only, no backend). Use CSS grid for responsive layout.

Step 7 — Update app/layout.tsx: import Navbar, Footer, CartProvider. Add Sonner Toaster (import from sonner — already in package.json? check: sonner is NOT in package.json, so add it: `npm install sonner`). Wrap body children with CartProvider. Add <Navbar /> above main, <Footer /> below. Keep existing Geist font setup. Update metadata title to 'Kartiva'.

Step 8 — Create app/(auth)/layout.tsx. Centered card layout: full-screen flex, centered card max-w-sm, Kartiva logo at top. No Navbar/Footer (auth pages are standalone). Must export default and accept { children: React.ReactNode }.

Step 9 — Create app/(dashboard)/layout.tsx. Sidebar layout: left sidebar with nav links (Profile /account/profile, Addresses /account/addresses, Orders /account/orders, Notifications /account/notifications), main content area. Calls requireAuth() to protect all dashboard routes. Mobile: sidebar collapses or uses a Sheet-based drawer. NOTE: middleware protects /account/* so pages must be at /account/... — the (dashboard) route group must have pages under account/ subpaths OR the group folder itself maps to /account. Use app/(dashboard)/account/... structure so paths resolve as /account/profile, /account/orders, etc.

Step 10 — Create components/shared/ProductCard.tsx. Props: {id, name, slug, price, compareAtPrice, images, variants, category}. Shows: product image (next/image), name, price with compare-at strikethrough, 'Add to Cart' button. Links to /shop/[slug]. Mobile-first card with hover effect. Uses Button from @/components/ui/button.

Step 11 — Create components/shared/VariantSelector.tsx ('use client'). Props: {variants: ProductVariant[], selectedVariantId: string, onChange: (id:string)=>void}. Groups variant options by key (e.g. size, color from variant.options Record<string,string>). Renders button-group for each option key. Marks selected, disabled if stock=0.

Step 12 — Create components/shared/QuantitySelector.tsx ('use client'). Props: {value:number, min?:number, max?:number, onChange:(n:number)=>void}. - and + buttons with current value display. Clamps to min/max.

Step 13 — Create components/shared/CartItemRow.tsx ('use client'). Props: {item: CartItem (from types/cart.ts), onRemove, onQuantityChange}. Shows: image, name, variant title, price, QuantitySelector, remove button. Calls updateCartItemQuantity / removeFromCart server actions.

Step 14 — Create components/shared/OrderStatusBadge.tsx. Props: {status: string}. Maps order status enum values (pending, confirmed, processing, shipped, delivered, cancelled, refunded, returned) to colored Badge variants. Use Badge from @/components/ui/badge.

Step 15 — Create components/shared/AddressForm.tsx ('use client'). Props: {defaultValues?: Partial<Address>, onSubmit: (fd:FormData)=>Promise<void>, loading?:boolean}. Form fields: label (Home/Work/Other select), addressLine1, addressLine2 (optional), city, state (Indian states dropdown), postalCode (6 digits), isDefault (checkbox). Uses Input, Label, Select from installed shadcn components. Validates client-side with simple required checks.

Step 16 — Create components/shared/skeletons/ directory with: ProductCardSkeleton.tsx, ProductGridSkeleton.tsx (renders 8x ProductCardSkeleton), OrderRowSkeleton.tsx, PageSkeleton.tsx. Use Skeleton from @/components/ui/skeleton.

Step 17 — Create components/shared/EmptyState.tsx. Props: {icon?: LucideIcon, title: string, description?: string, action?: {label:string, href:string}}. Centered layout with icon, text, optional CTA Button/Link.
acceptance_criteria: `npm run build` completes without TypeScript errors after all components are created
Navbar renders with logo, nav links, cart badge, and user dropdown (or login link)
CartProvider context is accessible via useCart() in any client component
app/(auth)/layout.tsx and app/(dashboard)/layout.tsx exist and export valid default layouts
All skeleton components exist under components/shared/skeletons/
verification: Run `npm run build` from c:\E-Commerce — zero TypeScript errors, zero compilation failures
findings: 1. @base-ui/react Button does not support `asChild` prop — uses `render` prop instead (e.g. `render={<Link href='...' />`). All Button-as-link patterns use this approach. 2. Next.js 16 with cacheComponents:true is strict about static prerender: any component accessing cookies (getCart, getUser, requireAuth) must be inside a Suspense boundary OR have `export const instant = false`. Solution: CartProviderServer wraps server-side cart fetch and passes initialItems to CartProvider; Navbar is wrapped in Suspense in root layout; dashboard layout exports `instant = false`. 3. Footer.tsx used `new Date()` which triggers unstable prerender error — hardcoded year instead. 4. shadcn CLI `npx shadcn@latest add` fails with peer dep conflicts (vitest@5 vs @types/node); fixed by pre-installing radix-ui and vaul with `--legacy-peer-deps`, then running shadcn again. 5. CartProvider refactored to accept `initialItems` prop (server-fetched) rather than calling server action on mount, to avoid import chain analysis issues in Next.js 16 prerender.
